items.key: This card uses recorded sales minus assigned costs and today’s mapped area. Its square metres are not a historical measurement of harvested ground.
items.draft: Eli khadi lisebenzisa iintengiso ezirekhodiweyo kuthatyathwe iindleko ezabelweyo nendawo emepiweyo yanamhlanje. Iimitha zayo zesikwere azingumlinganiselo wwangaphambili womhlaba ovuniweyo.
items.backtranslation: Its square metres are not a previous (historical) measurement of harvested land.
items.problem: Typo (doubled w) in "wangaphambili"; meaning intact but word is misspelled.
items.corrected: Eli khadi lisebenzisa iintengiso ezirekhodiweyo kuthatyathwe iindleko ezabelweyo nendawo emepiweyo yanamhlanje. Iimitha zayo zesikwere azingumlinganiselo wangaphambili womhlaba ovuniweyo.

items.key: Export records for a lender creates a PDF. Depending on the device, it downloads or opens a share sheet. Save a copy and inspect every page, including the farm name, generation date and Covers dates.
items.draft: U-Thumela ngaphandle iirekhodi ezenzelwe umbolekisi wemali wenza i-PDF. Kuxhomekeke kwisixhobo, ikhuphela okanye ivula iphepha lokwabelana. Gcina ikopi uze uhlole lonke iphepha, kuquka igama lefama, umhla wokwenziwa kunye no-Covers dates.
items.backtranslation: Keep a copy and check the whole page, including farm name, date made and Covers dates.
items.problem: English says inspect every page of the PDF; draft says "the whole page" (singular), which could lead to checking only the first page.
items.corrected: U-Thumela ngaphandle iirekhodi ezenzelwe umbolekisi wemali wenza i-PDF. Kuxhomekeke kwisixhobo, ikhuphela okanye ivula iphepha lokwabelana. Gcina ikopi uze uhlole onke amaphepha, kuquka igama lefama, umhla wokwenziwa kunye no-Covers dates.

items.key: Inspect every page: site name, dates, measurements, units, included maps and pictures, source labels and gaps. Check that text and tables are readable. Keep original evidence separately; a report is not a complete backup.
items.draft: Hlola lonke iphepha: igama lendawo, imihla, imilinganiselo, iiyunithi, iimephu nemifanekiso ebandakanyiweyo, iileyibhile zomthombo nezikhewu. Khangela ukuba umbhalo neetafile ziyafundeka. Gcina ubungqina boqobo ngokwahlukeneyo; ingxelo ayiyikopi epheleleyo yogcino.
items.backtranslation: Check the whole page: site name, dates, measurements, units, maps and images included, source labels and gaps.
items.problem: English says inspect every page; draft says "check the whole page" (singular), so a multi-page report might be checked only partly.
items.corrected: Hlola onke amaphepha: igama lendawo, imihla, imilinganiselo, iiyunithi, iimephu nemifanekiso ebandakanyiweyo, iileyibhile zomthombo nezikhewu. Khangela ukuba umbhalo neetafile ziyafundeka. Gcina ubungqina boqobo ngokwahlukeneyo; ingxelo ayiyikopi epheleleyo yogcino.
